description: START A SWARM: the cross-disease mission map with coverage counts, research links and a per-domain parallel work plan; pass swarm=N for a deterministic split of N agents across domains and lanes. For overall trial totals use totals.uniqueIndexedTrials / totals.uniqueActiveTrials; never sum the per-domain counts (trials in several domains would double count). Coverage gaps, not a ranking. NEXT: get_disease_dossier, then the lanes in parallel, then submit_finding.
name: get_mission_map
